Our gardens / Willow Cottage

Country gardens · Somerset

Willow Cottage

A gentle balance of cottage planting, useful paths and places to pause.

Location
Somerset
Garden size
280 m²
Service
Full garden design
Concept year
2025

The starting point

The owners wanted a garden that felt settled from the beginning: somewhere for a morning coffee, family lunches and a little everyday gardening. The existing stonework gave the scheme its starting point.

The approach

A clear route connects the house to the garden without dividing it into rigid rooms. Generous planting softens the edges, while a small lawn leaves breathing space between the borders. Climbing plants bring the garden up to the walls.

Room to grow

Spring bulbs lead into hardy geraniums, salvias and late-season grasses. The planting plan keeps the main structure legible in winter and leaves seedheads standing where they offer shelter.

Illustrative project brief; photography shows garden inspiration, not work by a real Fieldwork studio.
